verdict.rationale: Whether a software product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for an AI creative platform like Pika, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a public source repository or an open-source license. The published OpenAPI spec and llms.txt describe a hosted API, not source code, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
